definitions.explanation: A state of being severely constrained or under pressure, typically referring to finances, resources, or situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逼迫|ひっぱく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逼迫|ひっぱく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The strain on the healthcare system is serious.

examples.japanese: {逼迫|ひっぱく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られた→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: I was forced to make a decision in a dire situation.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逼迫|ひっぱく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: public or company finances are under severe strain
- ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{逼迫|ひっぱく}: strain on the healthcare system (a word much used during the COVID-19 pandemic)
- ⟦{需給|じゅきゅう}→需給：05920_jukyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逼迫|ひっぱく}: a tight supply-demand situation (electricity, goods)
- {逼迫|ひっぱく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: a desperate situation

USAGE:
- Mostly news and official language about systems and resources (budgets, hospitals, power supply) running short. For a person short of money, ⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧ or ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧ is more natural.
